items.name: theme
items.title: Here Be Dragons Theme
items.description: Parchment, ink and blood: the full shadcn variable set plus the HBD palette, status and spell-school colours, radii and offset shadows. Merged into your CSS file — nothing is overwritten wholesale. Light, .dark and .high-contrast. Ships no font files: it only sets the font-family variables, so add @hbd/fonts for our typefaces or point the variables at your own.

items.name: fonts
items.title: Here Be Dragons Fonts
items.description: The Here Be Dragons typefaces — Cinzel, IM Fell English, Roboto and JetBrains Mono — as npm packages imported from your CSS, so your bundler serves them and nothing is fetched at runtime (offline and Electron safe). Optional: skip it, or override --font-display / --font-sans, to use your own.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: parchment-tinted open rows, blood-red open titles, IM Fell body copy.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Displays a callout for user attention. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: saturated status surface with a heavy left rule. Adds info, success, warning, error and sage-advice variants, banner and inline layouts, and AlertIcon and AlertAction parts.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: parchment panel, Cinzel title ruled off from the message, offset-shadow actions.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Displays content within a desired ratio. shadcn/ui API (Radix, numeric ratio) in the Here Be Dragons look: content is clipped and its direct child fills the box with object-fit: cover.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user. shadcn/ui API (Radix) in the Here Be Dragons look: parchment ring, muted fallback, overlapping group with a count bubble. Adds xs, xl and 2xl sizes.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge. shadcn/ui API (variant, asChild) in the Here Be Dragons look: compact Roboto pill in blood, parchment and ink. Adds success and warning variants.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: Cinzel display crumbs with a › separator and a hairline underline on hover.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button. shadcn/ui API (variant, size, asChild) in the Here Be Dragons look: display type, offset ink shadow, sharp corners. Adds a gold variant.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Groups related buttons together, joining their edges into one control. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: the halves share one offset ink shadow, as the old split button did.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A date field component that allows users to enter and edit date. shadcn/ui API (react-day-picker) in the Here Be Dragons look: raised parchment, Cinzel month caption, round blood-red selected days and half-filled range edges.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: parchment surface, Cinzel title, serif body, hairline footer rule. Adds size (sm, lg, flush), variant (bordered, elevated), interactive and asChild.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a parchment box with an offset shadow and a hand-drawn tick, crimson when checked or indeterminate.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A compact pill for tags, filters and attributes, with an optional icon, remove button and pressable toggle (Radix Toggle). Here Be Dragons component with a shadcn/ui-style API: default, primary, success, warning and destructive variants, sm/default/lg sizes and an outline style.

items.name: codeblock
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Displays code on a dark surface with an optional filename/language header, line-number gutter, copy-to-clipboard button and syntax token colours from the theme. Here Be Dragons component with a shadcn/ui-style composition API.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel. shadcn/ui API; unstyled like upstream, so it takes on the Here Be Dragons look of whatever you compose inside it.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Fast, composable, unstyled command menu for React. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a parchment search band over the select's option list, with ink focus rings on the active row. Adds a data-checked hook that gives the chosen item the select's gold edge.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a right click. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look, sharing the Dropdown Menu's raised parchment panel, Roboto items and blood-tinted destructive variant.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: parchment panel, Cinzel title, ruled header and footer, offset-shadow close button. Adds a size prop (sm, lg, full) on DialogContent.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A drawer component for React, built on Vaul. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a parchment sheet with a drag handle, Cinzel title and ruled header and footer.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a raised parchment panel with an ink-brown hairline, Roboto items, uppercase tracked group labels and a blood-tinted destructive variant.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Use the Empty component to display an empty state. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: faded ink illustration, Cinzel title, serif description. Adds size (sm, lg), variant (error, success) and a horizontal orientation.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Combine labels, controls, and help text to compose accessible form fields and grouped inputs. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: the compact 4px field rhythm, blood-red error text and Cinzel legends.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A dropzone that takes files by drag-and-drop or from the file picker, with a list of thumbnails, sizes, per-file progress and errors. Here Be Dragons component with a shadcn/ui-style composition API: accept, maxSize and maxFiles validation with a per-file reject callback.

items.name: full-banner
items.title: Full Banner
items.description: A full-page takeover with one dominant message: illustration, eyebrow, display heading, description, actions and meta, with an inverted ink scheme. Here Be Dragons component with a shadcn/ui-style composition API; maintenance, launch, error and success screens are composed from its parts.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: the raised parchment panel and pointing arrow of the Popover. Adds a showArrow prop.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Displays a form input field or a component that looks like an input field. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: parchment surface, ink border, gold focus. Adds sm/lg sizes and a data-valid success state.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Add addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: prefixes, suffixes and the password eye sit exactly where the old field drew them.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: Accessible one-time password component with copy paste functionality. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: separate ink-bordered cells in JetBrains Mono. Adds root-level aria-invalid / data-valid states.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A versatile component for displaying content with media, title, description, and actions. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: dense Roboto rows, hairline dividers, a blood bar on the current item. Adds an lg size.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Used to display textual user input from keyboard. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a small raised parchment keycap in JetBrains Mono with an ink edge.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: compact Roboto field label that dims with its disabled control.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a parchment bar with an ink-brown hairline whose open trigger is underlined in gold, opening the Dropdown Menu's raised parchment panel.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: A styled native HTML select element with consistent design system integration. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: the closed trigger of the old select, chevron included. Adds an lg size, a data-valid state and a muted placeholder for an empty-value option.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: The top navigation bar: brand on the left, links in the middle, actions on the right, with an off-canvas menu on small screens. A Here Be Dragons component with no shadcn/ui counterpart; composes Navigation Menu for the links and Sheet for the mobile menu.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: A collection of links for navigating websites. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: quiet ink links that take a parchment wash, over raised panels with an ink hairline.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: square ink cells with a blood-filled current page. Adds PaginationFirst, PaginationLast and PaginationInfo.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: raised parchment panel with a pointing arrow. Adds PopoverClose and PopoverFooter, a showArrow prop, and a ruled PopoverHeader that seats a close button beside the title.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look. Adds variant (success, warning, error), size (sm, lg), indeterminate, striped and segments props.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: ink rings filled crimson with a parchment dot.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a thin ink-on-parchment scrollbar that darkens under the pointer.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from — triggered by a button. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: an ink-bordered field whose chosen value becomes a manuscript chip, and a parchment list that marks the selected entry with a gold edge. Adds an lg trigger size and an optional clear button (onClear).

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Visually or semantically separates content. shadcn/ui API (orientation, decorative) in the Here Be Dragons look: a hairline rule with the 24px manuscript rhythm. Adds subtle/strong/gold/ornamental variants, dashed and double line styles, and labelled rules.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: parchment panel from any edge, Cinzel title, ruled header and footer. Adds wide, tall and showOverlay props on SheetContent.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A composable, themeable and customizable sidebar. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: parchment rail, small-caps group labels and a blood ribbon on the current row.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Use to show a placeholder while content is loading. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a parchment block with a sweeping shimmer.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: ink rail, crimson fill, parchment thumb. Adds a size prop (sm, lg) and an aria-invalid error look.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: An opinionated toast component for React. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: status-coloured parchment toasts with a thick left rule, HBD status glyphs, an underlined action and a countdown bar. Defaults to top-right, expanded stack, close button and a 5s duration.

items.name: spell-card
items.title: Spell Card
items.description: Displays a D&D spell as a parchment card: school colour band for the eight schools, ornamental gold corners, level badge, meta grid, description, At Higher Levels and footer. Here Be Dragons component with a shadcn/ui-style composition API.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indicator that can be used to show a loading state. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a crimson arc over a faint ring. Adds size (sm, lg, xl) and variant (muted, inherit) props.

items.name: stat-block
items.title: Stat Block
items.description: Displays a D&D 5e creature stat block: name and subtitle, AC/HP/Speed, ability score table with computed modifiers, property rows and trait/action sections inside a double red rule. Here Be Dragons component with a shadcn/ui-style composition API and a compact size.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A number input flanked by decrement and increment buttons, with min, max and step. Here Be Dragons component with a shadcn/ui-style API: a numeric value with onValueChange, sm/default/lg sizes and a thin variant that shrinks to its digits.

items.name: stepper-nav
items.title: Stepper Nav
items.description: Shows progress through the steps of a multi-step flow, horizontally or vertically. A Here Be Dragons component with no shadcn/ui counterpart: numbered blood-filled indicators, connectors and per-step status.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: an ink track that turns crimson. Adds a lg size.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A responsive table component. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: Cinzel small-caps headers, Roboto cells, hairline row rules, blood-tinted selection and sort. Adds size (sm, lg), bordered and striped.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A set of layered sections of content, known as tab panels, that are displayed one at a time. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: parchment folder tabs on an ink baseline with a blood ribbon on the active tab. Adds TabsBadge (count chip) and TabsScroller (overflow with prev/next buttons).

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea. shadcn/ui API (grows with its content) in the Here Be Dragons look: parchment surface, ink border, gold focus. Adds sm/lg sizes and a data-valid success state.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: Pick a time from scrolling hour, minute and AM·PM columns in a popover, with a type-to-set header and a Clear / Cancel / Confirm footer. Here Be Dragons component with a shadcn/ui-style composition API: a controlled 24-hour HH:MM value, 12- or 24-hour display and a minute step.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button that can be either on or off. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: display type and an offset ink shadow, turning crimson when pressed. Adds icon, icon-sm and icon-lg sizes.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a joined, ink-bordered row of display-type buttons with a crimson pressed state.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it. shadcn/ui API in the Here Be Dragons look: a small ink bubble with a pointing arrow.
